notes.title: Balloon Hater demo is now live!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

I’m excited to announce that the Balloon Hater demo is now available on Steam! 🎉
I decided to release it a bit ahead of Steam Next Fest so you’d have more time to check it out.

[h3]What’s in the Demo?[/h3]
[list]
[*] 3 types of balloons
[*] 10+ special bonus balloons
[*] 3 areas
[*] 8 weapons
[*] 40+ upgrades
[*] Drones, prestige, offline rewards
[/list]
[b]The demo will only be available from May 29 to June 16, so don’t miss it![/b]

Your feedback means a lot to me — feel free to share your thoughts, bug reports, and suggestions in the Steam discussions or through the forms:
✍️ Feedback
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSX3crvm6TmIICQGdiwhY48tCxm9RNewcoiIBTS0K-uRkHxQ/viewform
🐞 Bug
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdHsEkjJ2mWh2rrmbvl2iaHH1itFgHFWNvfDLa_DiAomO3ztw/viewform

👁[b] And don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540880/Balloon_Hater
Thanks for your support!

– Nikorych
